title: Custom Cherrypicking and Normalization From CSV
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Distribute buffer with p300
steps.instruction: Use the p300 single‑channel pipette to dispense buffer from a 12‑well reservoir into the specified wells of a 96‑well child plate, following the volumes, plate locations, and well locations listed in the uploaded CSV file.

steps.title: Transfer and mix plate contents
steps.instruction: Using either a p20 single‑channel or a p300 single‑channel pipette, transfer the contents of the specified wells from up to five 96‑well parent plates into the designated wells of the child plate, then mix, according to the plate locations, well locations, and volumes provided in the uploaded CSV file.
